throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: armsrl.w $r12, $r4, 14; armsrl.w $r13, $r5, 14; armsrl.w $r14, $r6, 14; armsrl.w $r15, $r7, 14; armsrl.w $r16, $r8, 14; armsrl.w $r17, $r9, 14; armsrl.w $r18, $r10, 14; armsrl.w $r19, $r11, 14
throughput.init: addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8; armmtflag $r0, 0x39
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 10 --init 'addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8; armmtflag $r0, 0x39' --asm 'armsrl.w $r12, $r4, 14; armsrl.w $r13, $r5, 14; armsrl.w $r14, $r6, 14; armsrl.w $r15, $r7, 14; armsrl.w $r16, $r8, 14; armsrl.w $r17, $r9, 14; armsrl.w $r18, $r10, 14; armsrl.w $r19, $r11, 14'
throughput.notes: 8 independent lanes take 16.00 cycles, i.e. 2 CPI. The instruction is a single uop; its conditional execution limits it to one per two cycles (armmfflag and armmove are not conditional on register data and run at one per cycle). Re-measured on 2026-11-17 on LA664, core 0, with --method slope (--unroll 250 --unroll2 1000) and confirmed with the 0x01 uop counter.

notes: LBT ARM-style instruction. Latency is recorded per register source operand and for the ARMFLAGS path.
